The proven failing layer is TURN_DISCOVERY: the 2026-10 ChatGPT build renamed every attribute the turn reader knew, so getChatGPTTurns() returned an empty list over a conversation that plainly held the authored Core (lineage=TURN_DISCOVERY reason=no-user-turn-discovered turns=0(u0/a0)), leaving the runtime nothing to adopt and the cell reading BUSY over an audit that is demonstrably running.
